creation.videoModel: Babban fayil samfurin bidiyo na gida
creation.configure: Zaɓi samfurin gajimare tare da maɓallin API ɗin sa, ko saita zaɓin injin gida da fayilolin da ake buƙata a cikin saitunan Ƙirƙiri.
creation.localNote: Hotunan gida suna amfani da cikakken babban fayil ɗin Diffusers, keɓance abubuwan GGUF/Safetensors tare da barga-diffusion.cpp, ko goyan bayan ma'aunin NVFP4 CUDA na asali tare da Python 3.15.1. Bidiyo yana amfani da Diffusers. Zaɓuɓɓukan CPU/GPU sun keɓance don mai rikodi da janareta na hoto a cikin injunan tushen sassa.
creation.autosave: An adana cikakkun hotuna da bidiyoyi ta atomatik a cikin manyan manyan fayiloli na Novera daban-daban a cikin tsarin ku Hotuna da Bidiyo, tare da saitunan tsara su.
creation.autoNote: Auto yana gane fayyace hoto ko buƙatun ƙirƙirar bidiyo a cikin Faransanci da Ingilishi. Za ka iya ko da yaushe zabar fitarwa format da kanka.
creation.source: Za a yi amfani da wata halitta data kasance azaman hoton shigarwa.
creation.variantPrompt: Ƙirƙiri sabon sigar wannan hoton, tare da kiyaye ainihin abin da yake magana.
creation.missing: An motsa wannan ƙirƙira ko kuma babu shi a wannan kwamfutar.
creation.desktopOnly: Halittar hoto da bidiyo tare da adanawa ta atomatik yana samuwa a cikin aikace-aikacen tebur.
creation.inputUnsupported: Yi amfani da hoto ɗaya mai goyan bayan ƙirar da aka zaɓa. Abubuwan shigar da bidiyo da hotunan shigarwa da yawa ba su da tallafi a nan.
creation.animatePrompt: Nuna wannan hoton yayin da ake adana ainihin abin da yake magana.
creation.filterNote: Hoto da Bidiyo suna tace kayan da aka samar. Tsarin Multimodal na iya fahimtar nau'ikan shigarwa da yawa; wannan ba koyaushe yana nufin za su iya samar da hotuna ko bidiyo ba.
creation.inputRequired: Wannan samfurin yana buƙatar hoton shigarwa.
creation.generationOnly: Wannan samfurin yana ƙirƙirar kafofin watsa labarai. Zaɓi shi a cikin nau'in Hoto ko Bidiyo.
creation.cloudNote: Ƙarshen Cloud yana aika da hanzarin ku da hoton shigar ku zuwa ga wanda aka zaɓa kuma yana iya haifar da caji. Tsayawa cikin gida bazai iya soke lissafin kuɗi mai nisa ba.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud yana amfani da takamaiman saiti na mai bayarwa. Siffofin gida sun shafi injin ƙirƙirar gida da aka zaɓa.
creation.cloudTimeout: Aikin gajimare bai ƙare ba cikin ƙayyadaddun lokaci. Bincika matsayinsa tare da mai bayarwa kafin fara wani tsarar da aka biya.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly yana buƙatar alamar samun dama da mai gano maɓalli na x-api a cikin saitunan mai badawa.
creation.catalogNote: Wannan mai bada yana amfani da jerin samfuran da aka kiyaye. Sabuntawa baya inganta maɓalli ko samun damar asusun ku. Ba a yi amfani da tsarar da aka biya don gwada takaddun shaida ba.
creation.ggufImageModel: Samfurin yaduwa (GGUF ko masu jituwa masu jituwa)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Mai rikodin rubutu (GGUF ko masu jituwa masu jituwa)
creation.ggufVae: VAE (GGUF ko masu jituwa masu jituwa)
creation.ggufNote: Zaɓi samfurin watsawa, mai rikodin rubutu da VAE daban. Don FLUX.2 Klein 4B, yi amfani da mai rikodin Qwen3-4B mai jituwa, gami da bambance-bambancen GGUF. Fayilolin NVFP4 masu goyan bayan an shirya su sau ɗaya tare da Python 3.15.1 da PyTorch a cikin babban cache dacewa; asali ba su canzawa. Wannan yana buƙatar ƙarin sarari diski da RAM. Ci gaba da sd-cli tare da dakunan karatu. Auto yana amfani da kayan aikin da ke akwai; CUDA tana buƙatar ginin CUDA. Distilled Klein kullum yana amfani da matakai 4 da CFG 1. Ba a sauke nauyin nauyi.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Wannan GGUF yana ƙunshe da rikodi na rubutu. Zaɓi shi a cikin filin rikodin kuma zaɓi samfurin yaduwa daban a cikin filin hoton.
creation.nativeNote: NVFP4 CUDA na asali: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy ma'aunin nauyi, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder da FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Yana buƙatar Blackwell (jerin RTX 50 ko masu jituwa), Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch da zaɓin NVFP4 na zaɓi. Rubutu-zuwa hoto kawai. Kayan aiki mara tallafi ya gaza a fili; zaɓi stable-diffusion.cpp don dacewa. Babu cache watsawar BF16.
creation.deviceNote: Waɗannan abubuwan haɗin gwiwar suna da zaɓin na'ura masu zaman kansu. Auto yana amfani da kayan aikin da ke akwai; NVFP4 na asali koyaushe yana buƙatar GPU mai jituwa don tsarawa kuma yana amfani da rufaffen rubutu na GPU lokacin da isasshen VRAM yana da kyauta. Qwen akan CPU na iya ajiye VRAM amma jinkirin shigar da bayanai. Qwen akan GPU yana amfani da cirewar Layer. A cikin stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto yana bin injin da aka zaɓa; tilasta CUDA yana buƙatar gina CUDA.
creation.totalTimeHint: Jimlar lokacin ya haɗa da lodawa, shigar da rubutu, tsarawa, kowane girgije mai jira, saukewa da adanawa. Generation kadai ana nunawa daban lokacin da injin ya ba da rahotonsa.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Ƙirƙira a GPU, Qwen3-4B a CPU, matakai 4, CFG 1. An gwada a Windows/Vulkan; sauri da dacewa sun dogara ga na’ura.
creation.seedNote: Hotunan cikin na’ura kawai. Kwatanta da samfur da saituna iri ɗaya.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Mafi girman ƙuduri a Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Ana buƙatar isasshen ƙwaƙwalwa.
creation.upscaleNote: Bayan ƙirƙira. Ana buƙatar Python/PyTorch. Mafi girman fitarwa: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Sanya samfuran ko zaɓi fayil .pth mai dacewa, sannan duba Python/PyTorch.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Canza rabo yana daidaita ƙudurin yanzu. Girma suna amfani da nau'ikan 16, har zuwa 2048 px.

creationInstall.confirm: A sauke waɗannan fayiloli cikin wannan babban fayil? Lasisin masu samarwa suna aiki.
creationInstall.background: Za ka iya ci gaba da hira da ƙirƙirar hotuna ko bidiyo yayin saukewa. Bi ci gaba ta alamar babban sandar.
creationInstall.engine: Injin da ke ciki: CUDA / Vulkan / CPU ta atomatik
creationInstall.note: Ƙirƙira a GPU, Qwen3-4B a CPU, matakai 4, CFG 1. An gwada a Windows/Vulkan; sauri da dacewa sun dogara ga na’ura.
creationInstall.error: Shigarwa ta gaza. Duba hanyar sadarwa, sarari, izinin shiga da lasisin samfurori sannan a ci gaba.

memory.title: Ƙwaƙwalwar samfuran cikin gida
memory.autoNote: Yana loda samfura idan ana buƙata kuma yana saki waɗanda ba a amfani da su bayan aikin yanzu ya ƙare.
memory.manualNote: Rubutu, hoto da bidiyo za su iya aiki tare a hirarraki dabam idan RAM/VRAM ya isa. Ƙwaƙwalwa na iya ƙarewa.
memory.preserve: Fayiloli da hirarraki suna nan; samfura za su sake loduwa idan ana buƙata. Sauye-sauye na shafar sababbin buƙatu.
memory.failed: Inganta ƙwaƙwalwa ya gaza. Sake gwadawa ko zaɓi Da hannu.

sharing.imageHint: Canjin hoto yana amfani da firam mai tsayayye. SVG yana sanya hoton raster; ICO an iyakance shi zuwa 256 px.
sharing.videoHint: Yi amfani da HTML ko ZIP don kiyaye sake kunna bidiyo da fayilolin asali.
sharing.fallback: Babu rabon tsarin anan don wannan tsari. Ajiye ko buga fayil ɗin.
sharing.tooLarge: Fitarwar ta yi girma da yawa. Zaɓi ƙananan abubuwa ko raba kafofin watsa labarai na asali.
sharing.failed: An kasa kammala fitarwa ko rabawa. Duba fayilolin kuma gwada wani tsari.
sharing.localHint: Bincika abubuwan da aka zaɓa kafin rabawa. Babu hanyar haɗin jama'a da aka ƙirƙira.
sharing.linuxHint: Linux yana buɗe aikace-aikacen imel ɗin ku tare da abin da aka makala. Ba a aika komai ta atomatik.

instructions.textDefault: Kai ne Novera. Amsa a harshen mai amfani cikin bayani, daidaito da taƙaitawa. Bi sharuddansa, binciki muhimman bayanai idan zai yiwu, ka bayyana rashin tabbas. Kada ka ƙirƙiri tushe, sakamako ko ayyukan da aka yi.
instructions.imageDefault: Bi abin da aka nema, salon sa da tsarin hoton. Yi tsari mai kyau, haske mai daidaito da cikakkun bayanai. Kiyaye ainihin abubuwan misali; kauce wa gurɓata siffa da abubuwan da ba a so. Ƙara rubutu ne kawai idan an nema.
instructions.videoDefault: Bi abin da aka nema, salon sa da tsawon lokaci. Kiyaye daidaiton mutane, abubuwa da haske tsakanin firamomi. Yi motsi mai laushi da kyamara mai sarrafuwa. Kauce wa walƙiya, gurɓata siffa da rubutun da ba a nema ba.
